title: One insert, all three cases
notes: Inserting 40 under the red 30 meets a red uncle, 70: case 1 recolors and moves the problem up to 60. Now 60 and its parent 80 are both red, the uncle 10 is black, and the path zigzags: case 2 rotates right at 80 and case 3 rotates left at 20, which puts 60 at the root.
